Tax Course Finder ("Tax Course Finder," "we," "us," or "our") respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect information when you visit taxcoursefinder.com, use our comparison tools, interact with provider listings, submit forms, subscribe to communications, or otherwise use our website and services.

Tax Course Finder is operated by Tax Course Finder LLC.

By using the website, you acknowledge the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect information in several ways.

Information You Provide to Us

Depending on how you use the website, you may provide:

  • Name
  • Email address
  • Telephone number
  • Company or school name
  • Business contact information
  • Information submitted through contact forms
  • Newsletter or marketing preferences
  • Provider verification or profile-claim information
  • Corrections or updates submitted regarding provider listings
  • Other information you choose to provide

Please do not submit Social Security numbers, taxpayer information, tax returns, financial account credentials, payment card information, or other highly sensitive personal information through general website forms unless we specifically request such information through an appropriate secure process.

Information Collected Automatically

When you use the website, we or our technology providers may automatically collect information such as:

  • IP address
  • Browser type
  • Device type
  • Operating system
  • Approximate geographic location derived from IP address
  • Referring website or source
  • Pages viewed
  • Search and filtering activity
  • Links clicked
  • Provider profiles viewed
  • Date and time of visits
  • Session information
  • Cookie or similar technology identifiers

We may use analytics technologies to understand how visitors use Tax Course Finder and improve the website.

2. How We Use Information

We may use information to:

  • Operate and maintain Tax Course Finder
  • Provide tax education provider comparisons
  • Improve search, filtering, and comparison features
  • Measure provider profile traffic
  • Track outbound referrals
  • Verify provider profiles
  • Process correction requests
  • Respond to inquiries
  • Detect fraud, abuse, spam, or security threats
  • Improve website performance
  • Conduct analytics
  • Send requested communications
  • Send marketing communications where permitted
  • Maintain business and accounting records
  • Enforce our Terms of Use
  • Comply with applicable laws and legal obligations

3. Cookies and Similar Technologies

Tax Course Finder may use cookies, pixels, local storage, tags, analytics tools, referral identifiers, and similar technologies.

These technologies may be used for website functionality, analytics, remembering preferences, measuring marketing campaigns, fraud prevention, and site improvement.

You may be able to control cookies through your browser settings or through a cookie preference tool provided on the website.

Disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality.

4. Analytics and Third-Party Technologies

We may use third-party service providers to help operate and analyze the website.

These providers may process information such as IP addresses, browser information, device information, pages visited, interactions, referral sources, and cookie identifiers.

The specific providers used by Tax Course Finder may change as our technology stack develops.

Where required by applicable law, we will provide appropriate choices concerning non-essential tracking technologies.

5. How We Disclose Information

We may disclose information to:

Service Providers

Companies that help us provide hosting, website infrastructure, analytics, email delivery, security, database management, customer support, payment processing, or similar services.

Education Providers

We may share provider-submitted business information publicly as part of a provider profile. We do not provide providers with personal information about website visitors.

Business Transactions

Information may be transferred in connection with a merger, acquisition, financing, sale of assets, restructuring, bankruptcy, or similar business transaction.

Legal and Safety Purposes

We may disclose information when reasonably necessary to comply with law, legal process, governmental requests, enforce our agreements, investigate suspected fraud or abuse, protect our rights or property, or protect the safety of users or others.

6. Third-Party Provider Websites

Tax Course Finder contains links to independent education providers and other third-party websites.

When you click a link and leave Tax Course Finder, the third party's privacy practices apply.

Tax Course Finder does not control how independent providers collect, use, store, or disclose personal information on their websites.

You should review the privacy policy of any third-party website before providing personal or financial information.

7. Sale or Sharing of Personal Information

Tax Course Finder does not sell personal information for money in the ordinary meaning of the word "sell."

Certain analytics, cookie, or tracking activities may nevertheless be considered a "sale," "sharing," or targeted advertising under some state privacy laws.

Where applicable law requires an opt-out, Tax Course Finder will provide an appropriate mechanism and honor legally required opt-out preference signals.

8. California Privacy Rights

California residents may have privacy rights under applicable California law.

Depending on the law applicable to Tax Course Finder and the circumstances, these rights may include the ability to request:

  • Access to certain personal information
  • Information regarding collection, use, or disclosure
  • Correction of inaccurate personal information
  • Deletion of certain personal information
  • Opt-out from certain sales or sharing of personal information
  • Limitation of certain uses of sensitive personal information
  • Non-discrimination for exercising applicable privacy rights

Not every right applies in every circumstance, and certain legal exceptions may apply.

Requests may be submitted to:

Email: [PRIVACY EMAIL]

We may need to verify your identity before processing certain requests.

Authorized agents may submit requests where permitted by applicable law, subject to verification requirements.

9. Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track

Some browsers provide privacy preference signals.

Traditional "Do Not Track" browser signals do not have a universally accepted technical standard, and Tax Course Finder may not respond to legacy Do Not Track signals.

Where applicable law requires Tax Course Finder to recognize Global Privacy Control or another legally recognized opt-out preference signal, we will process that signal as required.

10. Email Communications

If you subscribe to marketing communications, we may send information regarding Tax Course Finder, education providers, offers, resources, products, or services.

You may unsubscribe from marketing emails using the unsubscribe mechanism contained in the message.

Unsubscribing from marketing communications does not prevent us from sending necessary administrative, transactional, security, or service-related communications.

Submitting an inquiry or provider verification request does not by itself constitute consent to receive unrelated marketing communications where separate consent is required by law.

11. Data Retention

We retain personal information for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, including providing services, maintaining business records, preventing fraud, resolving disputes, enforcing agreements, and satisfying legal, accounting, or reporting obligations.

Retention periods may vary depending on the type of information and purpose for which it is processed.

12. Security

We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect information.

However, no website, computer system, transmission method, or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

You provide information through the internet at your own risk.

13. Children's Privacy

Tax Course Finder is intended for adults and is not directed toward children under 13.

We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13 through the website.

If we learn that personal information has been collected from a child under 13 without appropriate authorization, we will take reasonable steps to delete it.

14. Provider and Business Information

Some provider information displayed on Tax Course Finder concerns businesses rather than individual consumers.

We may obtain provider names, business addresses, websites, telephone numbers, course information, pricing, approval information, and similar information from publicly available sources, provider websites, regulatory sources, provider submissions, or other legitimate sources.

Providers may contact us to request review or correction of factual listing information.

15. Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.

The updated policy will be posted on this page with a revised "Last Updated" date.

Where required by law, we may provide additional notice of material changes.
